subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Inertia
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Inertia"** means a tendency to do nothing or to remain unchanged; it refers to a lack of activity or movement. (जड़ता)

 
 
• **Example: **His** inertia** prevented him from taking the necessary steps to improve his life.
 
 
 
• **"Inactivity" **refers to the state of being inactive; it is the lack of action or movement. (निष्क्रियता)
 
 
• **Example: **Prolonged **inactivity **can lead to various health issues.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Inertia' **is **'Inactivity'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Progression **(प्रगति): The process of developing or moving gradually towards a more advanced state.

 
 
• **Example:** The progression of technology over the years has been astounding.
 
 
 
• **Activeness **(सक्रियता): The quality of being active and energetic.
 
 
• **Example: **Her activeness in community events is commendable.
 
 
 
• **Energy** (ऊर्जा): The strength and vitality required for sustained physical or mental activity.
 
 
• **Example:** Children are full of energy and love to play all day.
